provenance: Controlled physical workbench benchmark protocol. Photographic data capture specification.

target_objects.description: White ceramic coffee mug with handle
Clear plastic or metal reusable water bottle

camera_rig_specification.recommended_sensor: DSLR, mirrorless, smartphone, or USB camera mounted to fixed tripod
camera_rig_specification.mounting: Rigid desktop or overhead boom arm looking downward at 45-60 degree oblique angle
camera_rig_specification.exposure: Manual mode with locked exposure time, aperture, ISO, and manual white balance
camera_rig_specification.focus: Manual focus locked on center workbench surface

calibration_specification.placement: Four perimeter corners of the active workbench area
calibration_specification.purpose: Provides reference planar coordinate frame and quantitative registration reprojection validation

sequences.description: All 5 objects remain in place across 5 identical visits. Measures false movement rate, false removal rate, and identity stability.

visits.scenario_description: Initial setup. All 5 objects present at baseline positions.
No physical changes. Baseline stability check 1.
No physical changes. Baseline stability check 2.
No physical changes. Baseline stability check 3.
No physical changes. Baseline stability check 4.

sequences.description: Mug is moved to temporary location in V3 and returned to original baseline in V4. Tests relocation detection and return-to-baseline reasoning.

visits.scenario_description: Baseline scene with all 5 objects.
Pre-movement baseline confirmation.
cup_01 moved >35px away to temporary location.
cup_01 returned to initial baseline position.
Scene remains stable at restored baseline.

sequences.description: Smartphone is relocated in V2 and remains in the new location for V3-V5. Tests persistent change tracking without track bifurcation.

visits.scenario_description: Baseline scene with all 5 objects.
phone_01 moved to new position >50px away.
phone_01 remains at the new position.
phone_01 remains at the new position.
phone_01 remains at the new position.

sequences.description: Water bottle is physically removed at V3 and remains absent. Tests two-visit vacancy confirmation policy and measures confirmation delay.

visits.scenario_description: Baseline scene with all 5 objects.
Pre-removal confirmation.
bottle_01 physically removed from scene (first visit absent: PENDING_REMOVAL expected).
bottle_01 absent for second consecutive visit (CONFIRMED_REMOVED expected).
bottle_01 continues to be absent (CONFIRMED_REMOVED maintained).

sequences.description: Paperback book is partially occluded in V2 (~30%) and heavily occluded in V3 (~70%), then revealed in V4. Tests distinguishing occlusion from removal.

visits.scenario_description: Baseline scene with all 5 objects.
book_01 partially occluded (~30%) by cardboard overlay.
book_01 heavily occluded (~70%).
Occluder removed; book_01 fully revealed.
Scene remains stable at revealed baseline.

sequences.description: Scene lighting is systematically varied across visits without physical object movement. Tests false movement invariance under illumination changes.

visits.scenario_description: Nominal ambient room lighting (~400-500 lx).
Dimmed lighting / shadows. All objects physically stationary.
Strong directional side lamp. All objects physically stationary.
High contrast overhead light. All objects physically stationary.
Restored nominal ambient lighting. All objects physically stationary.

sequences.description: Camera pose undergoes slight physical pan, tilt, and height jitter while workbench objects remain stationary. Tests planar registration limits.

visits.scenario_description: Nominal camera pose. Baseline scene.
Camera pan ~5 degrees to the left. Objects stationary.
Camera tilt ~5 degrees down. Objects stationary.
Camera height offset ~5-10 cm. Objects stationary.
Camera returned to nominal pose. Objects stationary.
